bse_R_autocorr_lag1_by_closing_method.note: NSE close was a 30-minute VWAP until 2026-08-02; the auction-era sample is only 50 sessions (descriptive). A VWAP close mechanically pushes the end-of-day drift into the next gap.

sp500_to_G_in_closing_auction_era.note: descriptive only (n=50): the S&P -> G relation does not depend on how the previous close is defined, the lagged-Indian-return relations might

capmkts_mechanical_overlap.note: BSE Ltd is a constituent of NIFTY Capital Markets (weights quoted by a web-search summary of the NSE Indices factsheet dated 2025-03-28: 22.88%; an Angel One article: 15.09%; NOT verified by this workstream - https://www.niftyindices.com/Factsheet/Factsheet_NiftyCapitalMarkets.pdf was not opened).  Share = w*var(R)/cov(R, index), an upper-bound style guide for how much of the BSE-sector covariance is BSE's own contribution.

diagnostics.lag1_autocorr_by_series_note: positive own-lag autocorrelation across the sector peers is consistent with a common mechanism (e.g. VWAP-based closes, slow sector information diffusion) rather than BSE-specific leadership; the data cannot separate these

G.caveat: composition chosen after F9 on the same sample (data snooping): its OOS R2 is an upper bound; coefficients of correlated predictors are not individually interpretable

R.caveat: composition chosen after F9 on the same sample (data snooping): its OOS R2 is an upper bound; coefficients of correlated predictors are not individually interpretable

live_state.sp500_partial_note: S&P 500 7797.72 at 2026-10-13T16:17:42Z (about 2h47m into the session) vs the 12-Oct close 7807.24 (equal to the FRED SP500 value).  The session closes 20:00 UTC = 01:30 IST on 14-Oct, after the cutoff; E[full-day return | partial] = partial return, remainder unknown.
live_state.increments_note: increment = coef * (x_live - sample mean of x): the shift of the 14-Oct conditional mean relative to the unconditional mean; increments of predictors in the same group are one signal (overlap), do not add them up.

gap_adjustment_14oct.model: G_k = a + b * SP500_prior_window; adjustment = b * (partial S&P return - sample mean S&P window return)
gap_adjustment_14oct.remaining_session_uncertainty: the S&P 500 value is a partial-session observation; E[full-day return | partial] = partial return (martingale), so the adjustment uses the partial return directly; the unobserved remainder only adds variance
gap_adjustment_14oct.recommendation: apply the mechanical adjustment (validated); effect is tiny relative to sd of G
